product_one_liner.value: CyberCube provides cyber-risk analytics and modeling that quantify cyber risk and its financial impact for insurers, reinsurers, brokers, and other organizations in the insurance ecosystem.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes itself as a cyber-risk analytics provider for the insurance industry and lists products for underwriting and portfolio risk analysis.

pricing_page.notes: The site directs prospective users to request a demo or contact the company; its navigation and product page do not publish a pricing page or prices.

named_customers.notes: CyberCube's client page includes named client testimonials, and its 2024 announcement identifies these organizations among previously announced clients.

employee_band.notes: Built In lists 138 employees, which falls in the 101-200 band; LinkedIn lists the broader range 51-200.

hq_location.notes: CyberCube identifies San Francisco as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company says it launched as a standalone, independent venture-backed company in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: CyberCube has multiple engineering-authored technical posts, including one on migrating AWS Lambda functions to ECS and another on implementing licensing and authorization using AWS services.

public_docs.notes: The site links to Help for existing users, but the help page says user resources are in a secured area; I found no public product documentation or developer portal with several public articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists roles, but the visible job titles do not include AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed CyberCube's product and AI information, privacy/security materials, and data-processing/subprocessor information available in the public search results; none identified a specific AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: CyberCube publicly announced SOC 2 Type II accreditation and ISO 27001 certification.

last_funding.notes: On 2025-10-01 CyberCube announced an investment of more than $180 million from Spectrum Equity. The announcement does not specify a formal round stage or exact amount; $180,000,000 is the disclosed lower bound.

raised_18mo.notes: The announced investment was dated 2025-10-01, within the 18 months preceding 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board lists a Senior Director, (Re)Insurance Sales role. It is a senior sales opening rather than an SDR/BDR/AE-specific title, but it is a current sales role.

launched_6mo.notes: On 2026-09-01 CyberCube announced six new AI Event Families and the I2T2 framework, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On 2026-02-09 CyberCube announced Chris Methven as CEO, succeeding Pascal Millaire, who became Senior Advisor.

crm_stack_signal.notes: CyberCube's data-processing agreement identifies HubSpot as a customer-relationship-management system/subprocessor.
